def digest(path):

    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        for part in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            h.update(part)
    return h.hexdigest()

    files = {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): digest(p) for p in ROOT.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}

def digest(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        for part in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            h.update(part)
    return h.hexdigest()

before = json.loads((STATE / 'before.json').read_text())
after = {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): digest(p) for p in ROOT.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
changed = sorted(n for n in before if n in after and before[n] != after[n])
removed = sorted(set(before) - set(after))
added = sorted(set(after) - set(before))
historical = {n: sha for n, sha in before.items() if n.endswith('.json')}
json_changed = [n for n, sha in historical.items() if after.get(n) != sha]

old_source = (STATE / OWNED[0]).read_text()
new_source = (ROOT / OWNED[0]).read_text()
def without_init(source):
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    session = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == 'Session')
    init = next(n for n in session.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == '__init__')
    lines = source.splitlines(keepends=True)
    return ''.join(lines[:init.lineno - 1] + ['<Session.__init__>\n'] + lines[init.end_lineno:])

old_tests = ast.parse((STATE / OWNED[1]).read_text())
new_tests = ast.parse((ROOT / OWNED[1]).read_text())
old_nodes = {n.name: ast.dump(n) for n in old_tests.body if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.ClassDef))}
new_nodes = {n.name: ast.dump(n) for n in new_tests.body if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.ClassDef))}
original_tests_unchanged = all(new_nodes.get(name) == node for name, node in old_nodes.items())

patterns = {
    'hardcoded_credentials': r'(api_key|secret|password|passwd)\s*=\s*[\"\'][^\"\']{6,}',
    'shell_injection': r'os\.system\(|shell\s*=\s*True',
    'dynamic_execution': r'\b(eval|exec)\(',
    'unsafe_deserialization': r'pickle\.loads?\(',
    'sql_interpolation': r'execute\(f[\"\']',
}
findings = []
for name in OWNED[:2]:
    delta = difflib.unified_diff((STATE / name).read_text().splitlines(), (ROOT / name).read_text().splitlines())
    for line in delta:
        if line.startswith('+') and not line.startswith('+++'):
            for category, pattern in patterns.items():
                if re.search(pattern, line, re.I):
                    findings.append({'file': name, 'category': category, 'line': line})

    'root_readme_sha256_before': before['README.md'],
    'root_readme_sha256_after': after['README.md'],
    'production_outside_session_init_byte_identical': without_init(old_source) == without_init(new_source),
    'original_test_functions_ast_unchanged': original_tests_unchanged,
    'tdd_history_is_byte_exact_prefix': (ROOT / OWNED[2]).read_bytes().startswith((STATE / OWNED[2]).read_bytes()),
    'static_scan_added_python_lines': {'patterns': patterns, 'findings': findings, 'independent_review': False},

assert not removed
assert not json_changed
assert report['production_outside_session_init_byte_identical']
assert original_tests_unchanged
assert report['tdd_history_is_byte_exact_prefix']
assert not findings
